title: FLUOCOL-1 : Intraoperative Indocyanine Green Fluorescence Angiography in Colorectal Surgery to Prevent Anastomotic Leakage
official: FLUOCOL-1 : Intraoperative Indocyanine Green Fluorescence Angiography in Colorectal Surgery to Prevent Anastomotic Leakage
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that the assessment of anastomotic perfusion using intraoperative fluorescence angiography (IOFA) with indocyanine green (ICG) will reduce AL in left-sided or high anterior resection with intraperitoneal anastomosis.

interventions.name: INFRACYANINE 25 mg/10 mL, poudre et solvant pour solution injectable

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Scheduled to undergo elective left colectomy or high rectal resection for cancer with intraperitoneal anastomosis.
2. Signed informed consent
3. Affiliated to the French social security system (CMU included).
4. Adult patients (age >18 years)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Emergent surgery
2. Inflammatory bowel disease
3. History of known allergy to indocyanine
4. Pregnant patients
5. Refusal to participate or inability to provide informed consent
6. Protected adults (individuals under guardianship by court order).
7. Rectal cancer requiring total mesorectal excision and anastomosis below the peritoneal reflexion
8. Colon cancer requiring total or subtotal colectomy defined as a right colectomy extended to the splenic flexure or more)
9. Colon cancer requiring transverse colectomy
10. Recurrent colorectal cancer
11. Locally advanced colorectal cancer requiring multi-visceral excision
12. History of colectomy
13. Associated concomitant resection of other organ (liver, etc.)
14. Previous pelvic radiotherapy for pathology unrelated to diagnosis with colon cancer e.g. treatment for prostate cancer
